pregunta: dame la tasa de aprobación en porcentaje de cada esquema de tarjeta, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql_referencia: SELECT c.card_scheme, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.auth_status='approved') / count(*) AS tasa FROM v_attempt_dedup p JOIN dim_card c ON c.card_sk = p.card_sk WHERE NOT p.is_test GROUP BY c.card_scheme ORDER BY tasa DESC
